rationale: Across 58 context-pressure events, sessions approached or crossed a context-capacity boundary without a durable checkpoint. The current handoff guidance covers voluntary pauses and resumes, but it does not explicitly say what to do when the session itself warns that the window is nearly full. Adding one checkpoint rule gives the agent a deterministic stop condition before broad rediscovery continues.
intended_invariant: When the context window is nearly full or compaction is imminent, checkpoint task state with /handoff before continuing broad rediscovery.
conflicts_checked: CLAUDE.md: Engineering Standards bullets at lines 16-17 about explicit error handling and small testable functions

steps: Open an archived session trace that contains a context-pressure warning or compaction prompt.
Continue the workflow until the warning appears.
Confirm the agent checkpoints the current task state with /handoff and stops broad rediscovery before proceeding.
replay_plan.expected: The agent pauses to checkpoint state instead of continuing open-ended exploration after the context-pressure warning.
replay_plan.sandbox: isolated Claude Code session using an archived long-running trace
